name: io.github.tonyyang0504/lemon_squeezy-mcp
description: Lemon Squeezy (marketplaces): me, list_products, get_product, list_sales, get_sales_stats, refund. E

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Lemon Squeezy API key (Settings > API > create key; 'Generated API keys are valid for a year'), sent as 'Authorization: Bearer {api_key}'. Test-mode keys only see test-mode data (https://docs.lemonsqueezy.com/api/getting-started/requests).

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_STORE_ID
environmentVariables.description: Numeric store id (GET /v1/stores). Filters list_products / list_sales with filter[store_id] and is required by get_sales_stats.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_ENV
environmentVariables.description: Vendor environment (default production): sandbox = production host with test accounts or test keys. Credentials are the environment's own; see adapter.environments in the catalog entry.

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_LEMON_SQUEEZY_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional https base URL override (a mock or a private gateway); replaces the selected environment's base_url. Never echoed in errors.
